description: energy-py is an ADGEfficiency repository for reinforcement-learning experiments in energy environments, starting with electric battery storage. It provides a Gymnasium battery-arbitrage environment, integration with Stable Baselines 3 agents and an experiment workflow that separates training and evaluation datasets. Historical electricity prices can drive the experiments, and Tensorboard records their progress. Coverage is globally configurable, not a specified grid or market; the README does not establish a uniform price period or time resolution. Public source and example execution commands are free under MIT. A limitation is that the documented environment addresses battery arbitrage, so broader network constraints or safe real-device control are not established. The short setup guide identifies concrete battery and historical-price experiment scripts, but their numerical behaviour was not tested in this review. The repository is reusable for storage-dispatch learning experiments and comparison with optimisation-based electricity models such as PyPSA (model-pypsa). No historical prices were downloaded and no agent was trained.
name: energy-py battery-arbitrage experiments
